summary: Batch 4 QA (Leads folder + Report a Bug ScreenHeader migration + gold theming) at 390x844 as forest@imosapp.com. Backend: /api/schedule/team returns real names (no 'Unknown', 65 items), /api/leads/?limit=100 draft_message contains no em-dash (U+2014) - both pytest cases PASS. Frontend: all 7 screens show the expected header title and back testid; specific findings below. /report-bug: title 'Report a Bug' + report-bug-header-back OK, placeholder has no em-dash, Suggestion + textarea + Send Report -> 'Report Sent!' screen renders (Thanks + Done text present). /settings/call-retries: title 'Call Retries' + call-retries-back OK, call-retries-save opacity 0.4 (dimmed) initially, tapping a cad-*-plus stepper enables it (opacity 1.0), Save does not crash. /admin/internet-leads: title 'Lead Source Queue', lead-queue-header-back + lead-queue-config-btn present, gear navigates to /admin/lead-sources, filter pills All/Queued/Sent/Failed render, page has no literal 'Unknown' and no em-dash, View Contact text color rgb(201,169,98) GOLD (not blue). /admin/lead-sources: title 'Lead Source Config', lead-sources-header-back + lead-sources-add-btn OK, empty state 'Create Lead Source' button has bg rgb(201,169,98) gold and color rgb(0,0,0) black. /admin/lead-sources/new: title 'New Lead Source', new-lead-source-header-back + create-btn (text color gold rgb(201,169,98)) OK, Assignment Method cards render (method-jump_ball / method-round_robin / method-weighted_round_robin) - selecting Round Robin gives border rgb(201,169,98) gold. /admin/lead-connect: title 'Connect Zapier / Make', lead-connect-back OK, Facebook Lead Ads card + 'Open the Zapier template' button render. Back-nav fallback: opening /admin/lead-connect directly then tapping lead-connect-back navigates to /more (no history) - VERIFIED. /admin/team-availability: title 'Team Availability' with 'Updated 06:08 PM' subtitle, team-availability-header-back + team-availability-refresh-btn OK, refresh works without error, page has no literal 'Unknown' (63 On Shift / 1 Off Shift / 64 Total).

ui_bugs.issue: Done button lacks data-testid='report-bug-done-btn'. The Done text is present and clickable but the QA-required testid is missing. Only testids on success screen: ['report-bug-header','report-bug-header-back'].

issues: Default-selected 'Jump Ball' card renders border color rgb(255,149,0) (iOS system orange) instead of gold rgb(201,169,98). Once the user taps a different card (Round Robin / Weighted Round Robin) the highlight is correctly gold. Only the pre-selected default retains the orange accent - inconsistent with the 'highlight in gold, not blue' theming spec.

action_items: Add data-testid='report-bug-done-btn' to the Done button on the /report-bug 'Report Sent!' success screen.
Change the initial/default-selected Assignment Method card highlight color on /admin/lead-sources/new from iOS orange rgb(255,149,0) to gold rgb(201,169,98) to match the color used after a user tap.
critical_code_review_comments: Selection-highlight color for Assignment Method appears to have two code paths (default vs user-selected). Consolidate to a single 'active' style so the default pre-selection uses the same gold as any subsequent selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch 4 essentially passes. Two follow-ups: (1) missing data-testid='report-bug-done-btn' on /report-bug success screen Done button; (2) /admin/lead-sources/new default-selected 'Jump Ball' card highlight uses iOS orange rgb(255,149,0) instead of gold - manual selection uses gold correctly. Everything else including headers, back testids, gold theming (View Contact, Create Lead Source, Create text btn), backend schedule/team name fallback and leads em-dash strip - verified.
rca of the issue: The /report-bug success view was likely not updated to include the required testid during the ScreenHeader migration. The Assignment Method card component appears to use a hard-coded iOS-orange for the default variant while dynamic user selection reads from the gold accent constant.
